verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a first-party API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. Agent-oriented surfaces back this up: an official MCP server, the datadog-ci CLI, and an llms.txt documentation index. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at the common candidate paths, which is a gap for machine discovery but does not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence detail on API coverage and authentication beyond the reference page title, and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.
